QUOTE: "So the actual database write is `database.write` plus `writer.batch(...)` inside `BaseDataOperator.batchRecords`. It is the only place these handlers touch the write API."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says writes are centralized in `BaseDataOperator.batchRecords`. It never gives the reason the item requires, that each mixin is constrained to extend ServerDataOperatorBase. It says only that handlers are `(superclass) => class extends superclass`.
